items.markdown:
You can extend a Thailand tourist visa or visa exemption for 30 days by visiting a local [Thailand immigration office](https://findingginamarie.com/articles/thailand-visa-extension-process) , paying a 1,900 Baht fee, and submitting the required paperwork.[](https://findingginamarie.com/articles/thailand-visa-extension-process) [[1]](https://findingginamarie.com/articles/thailand-visa-extension-process)[[2]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-visa-types)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WcfocXVpMH8)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yrm8oT4_hDc&t=75)

Requirements and Documents

- **Passport** : Original passport with a valid entry stamp or tourist visa.
- **Application Form** : Completed **TM.7** extension form.
- **Photograph** : One recent 4cm x 6cm passport-sized photo.
- **Fee** : 1,900 Thai Baht in cash.
- **Accommodation Proof** : Copies of your hotel details or **TM.30** form from your landlord, plus your current local address and phone number.[](https://findingginamarie.com/articles/thailand-visa-extension-process) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aHW1S8x7T-w)[[2]](https://www.tratimmigration.com/how-to-extend-a-tourist-visa/)[[3]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)

Process Steps

- **Visit Office** : Go in person to the nearest immigration office before your current stay expires.
- **Submit Paperwork** : Hand in your documents, application, and photo for review.
- **Biometrics** : Have your photo taken by immigration staff.
- **Receive Stamp** : Pay the 1,900 Baht fee and wait for your passport to be returned with the 30-day extension stamp.[](https://findingginamarie.com/articles/thailand-visa-extension-process) 

If you'd like, let me know:

- **Which city or province** you are currently staying in
- Whether you entered on a **visa exemption** or a **pre-arranged tourist visa** 

I can give you the specific local immigration office details or extra tips.
